notes.title: Improvements to employees, texts and sizes (update 1.2)
notes.notes:
Some changes and improvements that you requested have arrived at Conradito Cafézito!
Most of the improvements and bug fixes have been reported by you on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3235270/discussions/]Community Forum[/url]! Thank you for your participation!

[h2]Game Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] From now on, all employees are saved when closing/opening the game! Both their names and appearances.
[*] The floating tip for cafés and items in general now no longer exceed the screen size of the game.
[*] The text size for the flavor expedition has been increased.
[*] The value displayed by vendors has been fixed and now shows the correct amount.
[*] Fixed a bug where, in some cases, when closing and reopening the game, the earnings per second would increase.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could crash after closing/reopening with all 10 expeditions completed.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Store Updates[/h2]
[list]
[strike][*] [b]A new [u]secret[/u] achievement has been added![/b] [spoiler]0.05% chance of occurring in the game[/spoiler][/strike] ❌ [b]removed[/b]
[*] Achievements have been translated into German.
[/list]

notes.title: Improvements on employees, upgrades, and added German language (update 1.1)
notes.notes:
[b]German Language Added to the Game![/b]
[i]I have a lot to thank the German community for playing so much Conradito Cafézito! As a token of appreciation, I’ve brought the full German translation. [u]Note[/u]: it still needs review![/i]

[h2]Expansions[/h2]
[u]Coffee Cultivation:[/u]
[list]
[*] From now on, in the Coffee Cultivation expansion, the seed prices will [b]update [/b][b]immediately [/b]after purchasing a new plot.
[*] Once you reach the maximum number of plots, purchases will be blocked and the price will change to "max" to indicate that you’ve hit the limit.
[/list]
[u]Flavor Expedition:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]All dialogues have been changed to something more creative![/b]
[/list]

[h2]Upgrade Tab[/h2]
[list]
[*] The "Tip Incentive" and "Loyalty Card" actions are now also triggered by employees!
[*] The "Production Control" upgrades have been modified. All items in this category have increased from 10% to 20% automatic speed.
[*] The "Gourmet Coffee" upgrade’s permanent bonus has been increased from 100 to 125.
[*] In "Boosting Morale," the employee speed has been increased from 12% to 25%.
[/list]

[h2]Events[/h2]
[u]“Magic Fertilizer” Event:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the "Magic Fertilizer" event where coffee plants weren’t generating money when harvested.
[*] In the "Magic Fertilizer" event, the event response time after accepting it has been reduced from 1.5 minutes to 25 seconds.
[/list]
[u]Other Events:[/u]
[list]
[*] In the "Price Increase" event, the penalty response for coffee earnings has been reduced from 70% to 50%.
[*] In the "Help the Neighbor" event, a bug was fixed where an extra plot would be added even if the maximum number of plots had already been reached.
[/list]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*] German language added to the game.
[*] Now, when switching languages during the game, a message will appear encouraging players to restart the game client.
[*] The possible names for some employees have been changed to be more easily pronounced in all languages.
[*] Some terms in English and Portuguese have been corrected.
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new [b]rare employee[/b] has been added! With approximately a 0.05% chance, you may have a special employee working for you.
[*] The description of the item "Multiple Espresso Machine" has been updated.
[*] The new Conradito Cafézito website has been added to the menu under "Information."
[/list]

Once again, I’d like to thank the German community for embracing the game so warmly!
Finally, I’m excited to announce that the [b]website[/b] for Conradito Cafézito is now live. Visit:
[url=https://conraditocafezito.com]conraditocafezito.com[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tnRwhwL.png[/img]

notes.title: More Useful Employees (update 1.0.6)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The upgrades [i]Premium Coffee Line[/i] and [i]Gourmet Brand[/i], which previously increased the permanent gain per coffee only for coffees made by you, now [b]also apply to coffees made by employees[/b]!
[*] A new statistic has also been added to the panel, showing how much additional coffee gain you have received throughout the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix with branches (atualização 1.0.5)
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with branches when the wedding event occurs. Previously, whether the branch was added or removed, the purchase price was not updated. Now everything works correctly.

notes.title: Version Notes - Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the users who reported bugs, both from the Steam community and my social media. Here are the changes made:

[list]
[*] Added a new "Exit Game" button for easier game closure.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Advertising" upgrade bonus was not being applied correctly after purchase.
[*] Adjusted the values shown by the resellers, ensuring they now match the actual amount you will receive.
[*] Revised the reseller income system with adjustments to the amounts earned.
[*] Fixed an issue where the resellers would revert to the same ones from the beginning of the first game if you finished the game, closed it, and reopened it.
[*] Fixed a bug where the permanent event bonuses were disappearing from the screen, especially after restarting the game. They are now displayed correctly.
[*] Resolved an issue where coffee plant and seed data wasn't being saved. Now everything is saved properly.
[/list]
